placements.title: Verification of recovery readiness through continuous operational rehearsal
placements.frame: How does the organization ensure its critical recovery systems are actively proven rather than assumed?

placements.why: Quinton articulates the core operating principle that a rollback capability does not truly exist unless proven through continuous scheduled rehearsal, setting a monthly cadence and assigning clear leadership ownership.
placements.title: Unrehearsed recovery capabilities are nonexistent in practice
placements.frame: How does regular rehearsal define whether an operational safeguard or rollback capability actually exists?
